title: The Captain and the Mechanic
action: Tomkin and Penny patrol the storm-lashed lighthouse catwalk.
camera: continuous medium tracking shot moving backward along the curved catwalk ahead of the pair
dialogue: TOMKIN: Forward! The sea shall know our courage! | PENNY: Watch your footing, Captain.
sfx: howling gale, driving rain on iron, metallic creaks, footsteps on wet grating, thunder

title: The Intruder Strikes
action: An armored drone crashes onto the catwalk.
camera: whip-pan from the dark ocean to the impact point on the catwalk
dialogue: PENNY: That is definitely not a seagull.
sfx: screaming descent, heavy metal impact, sparks, steam hiss, rain

title: The Masked Vigilante Drops In
action: A masked acrobat swings down and intercepts the drone.
camera: low-angle tilt following the hero's swing down from the spire
sfx: cable zip, whoosh, heavy kick impact, metal clang, landing thud, rain

title: Tripartite Counterattack
action: The trio disable the drone together.
camera: stylised slow-motion orbit around the trio and the drone
sfx: slowed-down rain, straining cables, metal prying, crackling blue sparks

title: The Butter Tub Protocol
action: Tomkin traps its sparking core under a yellow tub.
camera: push-in from medium to close-up on the butter tub
dialogue: PENNY: You saved us with a butter tub.
sfx: skittering metal, plastic thunk, muffled fizzing, rain easing

title: Repairs and Sunrise
action: They enjoy a brief golden dawn.
camera: slow crane up and around the trio to reveal the sunrise over the sea
sfx: gentle wind, distant gulls, dripping water, wrench ratchet

title: The Deep Rumble
action: Emerald light boils in the sea below.
camera: over-the-shoulder from the catwalk, then tilting down the cliff to the sea
dialogue: PENNY: That glow is coming from below.
sfx: deep underwater rumble, rising wind, waves on rocks

title: The Amphibious Leviathan
action: A barnacled mechanical crab climbs the cliff.
camera: low-angle from the rocks looking up as the walker climbs
sfx: crashing surf, grinding metal, hydraulic hiss, rock cracking, deep mechanical groan

title: Aerial Line and Ground Wire
action: Penny rigs a grounding circuit while the hero deflects a claw.
camera: dynamic handheld-style move between Penny's hands and the hero's fight
sfx: cable clamps, wrench clicks, whoosh of a giant claw, metal clang, wind

title: The Sovereign Strike
action: Tomkin knocks the tub into the walker reactor, disabling it.
camera: slow-motion climax tracking the butter tub through the air
sfx: slowed whoosh, plastic thunk, electrical burst, sliding metal, huge splash

title: False victory
action: The walker sinks but an emerald beacon pulses beneath the waves.
camera: aerial descent toward the churning water where the walker sank
sfx: bubbling, sinking groan, then a low rhythmic underwater pulse

title: A hidden signal
action: Penny detects a repeating signal from the drone core.
camera: close two-shot pushing in on the butter tub
sfx: rhythmic electronic beeping, wind, rain

title: The broken lantern
action: The lighthouse lantern flickers and goes dark.
camera: slow pan across the great lens as it fails
sfx: electrical flicker, grinding gears winding down, sudden silence, wind outside

title: Distress call
action: A fishing boat radios that it cannot see the rocks.
camera: push-in on the crackling radio set with Penny rushing in
sfx: radio static, garbled distress call, rain on glass, waves

title: No time to waste
action: Penny estimates the boat will reach the reef before dusk.
camera: medium shot, Penny at the chart desk with the window behind
dialogue: PENNY: That boat needs our light.
sfx: chart rustling, divider clicks, distant thunder

title: Tomkin takes command
action: Tomkin declares an emergency rescue operation.
camera: low angle making Tomkin look grand
sfx: cape swish, ladle ring, thunder

title: A map in brass
action: Penny opens a corroded chart case in the keeper room.
camera: close-up on Penny's hands and the chart case
sfx: corroded hinge creak, paper unrolling

title: The old power room
action: The trio descend a winding spiral stair.
camera: overhead looking straight down the spiral as they descend
sfx: echoing footsteps on stone, dripping water, wind moaning in the stairwell

title: Footprints in dust
action: They find mechanical claw marks on the lower landing.
camera: low ground-level shot along the dusty floor
sfx: lamp hiss, dust settling, distant metallic creak

title: The hidden hatch
action: A hatch reveals a flooded maintenance tunnel.
camera: overhead looking down into the hatch
sfx: heavy iron hatch groaning open, echoing drips, lapping water

title: Into the tunnel
action: The masked hero leads them into knee-deep water.
camera: tracking backward ahead of the trio wading
sfx: wading splashes, echoing drips, ladle paddling

title: Echoes in the dark
action: A distant mechanical tapping answers Tomkin’s ladle.
camera: slow push-in on Tomkin, the dark tunnel beyond
sfx: two ladle taps on iron, silence, a distant answering mechanical tapping

title: The guardian swarm
action: Small maintenance drones emerge from the ceiling.
camera: upward tilt to the ceiling as the swarm emerges
sfx: chittering mechanical legs, buzzing rotors, splashes

title: A narrow escape
action: The hero webs a door while Penny reroutes the lock.
camera: medium shot at a heavy bulkhead door
sfx: cable launches, net thwump, sparking wires, buzzing swarm, heavy door clang

title: The butter tub returns
action: Tomkin catches a loose gear before it hits a switch.
camera: close-up following a falling gear
sfx: gear clanking, whoosh, plastic thunk, relieved sigh

title: The signal room
action: They enter a chamber of antique radios and new circuitry.
camera: slow reveal dolly into the chamber
sfx: humming valves, rhythmic electronic pulse, static

title: An impossible diagram
action: Penny finds a schematic linking the drones to the lantern.
camera: over Penny's shoulder onto a wall schematic
sfx: sheet swish, humming circuitry

title: The first clue
action: A coded message reads: KEEP THE LIGHT DARK.
camera: close-up on a ticker-tape printer, then Penny's face
sfx: chattering ticker printer, paper tear

title: The ghost transmission
action: A recorded keeper warns of a machine beneath the sea.
camera: slow push-in on a reel-to-reel recorder
sfx: reel-to-reel spinning, crackly old recording of a muffled warning voice (unintelligible), hum

title: A promise
action: Penny insists they must save the boat and the lighthouse.
camera: medium three-shot, Penny turning to the others
dialogue: PENNY: We need the lantern working.
sfx: switch click, hum fading

title: Back to the balcony
action: Wind rises again as they climb to the catwalk.
camera: low angle looking up the stair as they climb to a door bursting open
sfx: running footsteps, door bang, howling wind and rain

title: The boat on the horizon
action: A small fishing boat appears beyond the reef.
camera: long-lens shot over the waves to the horizon
sfx: crashing waves, groaning hull, wind

title: A second wave
action: Three scout drones rise from the sea.
camera: wide shot from the railing looking out to sea
sfx: water bursting, whirring rotors, rising electronic whine

title: The hero leaps
action: The masked hero vaults toward the nearest drone.
camera: dynamic tracking shot following the hero's vault
sfx: running steps, cable zip, rotor stutter, wind

title: Penny improvises
action: Penny builds a reflector from polished salvage.
camera: close on Penny's hands at work, then her determined face
sfx: metal bending, wrench clanks, wire twisting, rain

title: Tomkin distracts
action: Tomkin challenges a scout with theatrical fencing moves.
camera: medium shot circling Tomkin and a scout
sfx: ladle clangs, rotor buzz, swish of cape

title: The first scout falls
action: A web line redirects a drone into a harmless net.
camera: wide shot tracking a redirected drone
sfx: cable tension, whoosh, net thwump, rotor sputter

title: The second scout
action: Penny blinds a sensor with the reflector.
camera: over Penny's shoulder at the incoming drone
sfx: lightning crack, flash zap, wobbling rotor, clang

title: A narrow ledge
action: Tomkin scrambles across wet masonry with the butter tub.
camera: side tracking shot along the tower wall, sheer drop below
sfx: scrabbling claws on stone, crumbling grit, wind, distant surf

title: The final scout
action: A ladle strike trips the final scout’s power latch.
camera: low angle on Tomkin leaping at the final scout
sfx: ladle whack, latch click, power-down whine, metal clatter

title: Moment of calm
action: The three regroup as the boat drifts closer.
camera: slow push-in on the three regrouping, the boat visible far behind them
sfx: heavy breathing, rain, distant waves on the reef

title: The lantern mechanism
action: Penny opens the rusted lantern drive assembly.
camera: close-up on the rusted drive assembly
sfx: bolts unscrewing, hinge creak, wind against the windows

title: Missing gear
action: The key brass drive gear has been stolen.
camera: insert on the empty gear shaft, then Penny's reaction
sfx: hollow metal tap, wind

title: A clever replacement
action: Penny studies the salvaged drone gear.
camera: close two-shot at the workbench
sfx: metal scraping, clicks, rain on glass

title: The wrong fit
action: The gear spins but slips under load.
camera: insert on the gear in motion
sfx: cranking, grinding screech, slipping gear clatter

title: Tomkin’s idea
action: Tomkin points at the butter tub rim as a spacer.
camera: push-in on Tomkin's bright idea
sfx: plastic tapping, excited chirp

title: The temporary fix
action: Penny cuts a flexible shim from the tub lid.
camera: close-up on Penny's hands cutting
sfx: plastic snipping, wrench ratchet

title: A spark of hope
action: The lantern rotates once before the generator fails.
camera: low angle on the turning lens
sfx: gears turning, rising hum, distant generator cough, power dying

title: Power outage
action: The entire tower shudders and the lights go out.
camera: wide shot as the tower shakes
sfx: deep rumble, rattling glass, power-down thunk, thunder

title: The lower generator
action: They descend to restart the backup generator.
camera: tracking down the stairs behind Penny
dialogue: PENNY: We can reverse the current.
sfx: hurried footsteps, echoing stairwell, rumbling

title: A flooded staircase
action: Seawater surges into the bottom of the tower.
camera: high angle looking down at rising water
sfx: rushing water, splashes, groaning stone

title: The trapped door
action: An iron door jams, separating Penny from the others.
camera: medium shot at the iron door as it slams
sfx: iron door slam, jammed latch rattle, water sloshing

title: Penny on her own
action: Penny uses her wrench to free the door latch.
camera: close-up on Penny working the latch
sfx: straining wrench, rusty shriek, clunk

title: Tomkin holds the line
action: Tomkin wedges the ladle against the closing gate.
camera: low angle on Tomkin and a sliding gate
sfx: grinding gate, creaking ladle, straining grunt

title: The hero returns
action: The masked hero braces the gate and pulls them clear.
camera: medium shot as the hero braces the gate
sfx: straining metal, gate slam, splashes, relieved breathing

title: A dangerous discovery
action: A green power conduit runs beneath the generator.
camera: low angle along the floor to a glowing conduit
sfx: grate scraping, pulsing electrical hum

title: The leviathan awakens
action: A second larger walker stirs under the surf.
camera: wide shot of the surf from the cliff, lightning revealing the shape
sfx: deep mechanical groan, surging water, thunder

title: The stakes rise
action: The machine begins drawing power from the lighthouse.
camera: tracking along the conduit to the generator gauges
sfx: electrical draining whine, falling gauge clicks, hum

title: Penny’s plan
action: Penny proposes reversing the stolen power through the beacon.
camera: medium three-shot around the switchboard
sfx: chalk scratching, generator hum

title: Three tasks
action: They divide the job into climbing, rewiring and distraction.
camera: slow push-in as they split up
sfx: rumbling, quick footsteps

title: The hero climbs
action: The hero ascends the exterior tower in driving rain.
camera: aerial shot rising alongside the hero
sfx: cable launches, winch whirr, wind and rain, crashing waves

title: Penny rewires
action: Penny swaps the power bus using insulated tools.
camera: close-up on Penny's insulated tools at the switchboard
sfx: bolt clicks, metal sliding, generator hum

title: Tomkin guards
action: Tomkin keeps small drones away from the switchboard.
camera: low angle circling Tomkin
sfx: ladle bonks, buzzing drones, plastic thunk

title: The first attempt
action: The generator sputters, then cuts out.
camera: medium on the generator as Penny throws the lever
sfx: lever clunk, sputtering engine, wheeze, silence

title: The missing connection
action: Penny spots a broken grounding strap.
camera: insert on a frayed broken strap, then Penny's eyes
sfx: lamp swing, cable rustle, rain

title: A risky crossing
action: The hero crosses a shattered bridge to retrieve a cable.
camera: side tracking shot along the shattered bridge
sfx: creaking iron, rattling planks, wind, surf below

title: A sudden collapse
action: The bridge gives way as he catches the cable.
camera: wide shot as the bridge collapses
sfx: snapping iron, collapse, falling debris, rushing wind

title: The rescue line
action: A white line catches him above the rocks.
camera: downward shot as the line snaps taut
sfx: cable launch, hook clank, sudden taut twang, crashing waves

title: Cable delivered
action: The hero swings the cable into Penny’s hands.
camera: through the power-room window as the cable arrives
sfx: whoosh, glass rattling, cable thump into gloves

title: Circuit complete
action: Penny closes the final safe insulated connection.
camera: close-up on the final connection, pulling out to Penny
dialogue: PENNY: Now! Turn the beacon on!
sfx: bolt ratchet, cover clank, generator humming to life

title: The second leviathan
action: The larger walker rises against the lighthouse.
camera: extreme low angle from the base of the tower
sfx: colossal groan, grinding rock, hydraulic blasts, surf

title: A giant shadow
action: Its armored claw blocks the morning sky.
camera: upward shot from the catwalk as the claw rises
sfx: dripping water, deep hydraulic hiss, wind dropping away

title: The catwalk buckles
action: Stone cracks beneath the team’s feet.
camera: ground-level shot as cracks race across the stone
sfx: cracking stone, bending iron, rumble

title: Penny holds fast
action: Penny anchors the lantern drive while the hero protects her.
camera: medium shot through the lantern-room glass
sfx: tinkling glass, rumbling, straining gears

title: Tomkin’s final charge
action: Tomkin sprints toward the control lever.
camera: fast tracking shot alongside Tomkin
sfx: pattering paws, cracking stone, cape flapping

title: The hero’s web shield
action: The hero catches falling debris with a web canopy.
camera: upward shot as debris falls
sfx: cable launches, net stretch, heavy debris thuds, rumbling

title: The mechanical heart
action: Penny reveals the leviathan’s exposed green receiver.
camera: over Penny's shoulder to the walker's chest
sfx: metal prying, pulsing hum

title: The beacon ignites
action: The lighthouse sends a focused beam through sea mist.
camera: wide shot following the beam out to sea
sfx: lever clunk, rising hum, bright beam whoosh

title: The signal reverses
action: The receiver overloads with harmless arcs of light.
camera: close-up on the receiver overloading
sfx: crackling arcs, overloading whine, powering down

title: The leviathan retreats
action: The walker releases the cliff and sinks offshore.
camera: wide shot from the catwalk looking down
sfx: grinding release, huge splash, sinking groan, waves

title: The boat finds the channel
action: The fishing boat follows the beam away from the rocks.
camera: aerial shot following the boat through the channel
dialogue: RADIO: Lighthouse, we can see the channel. Thank you!
sfx: engine putter, gentle waves, radio crackle

title: The keeper’s thanks
action: A grateful voice crackles over the radio.
camera: medium shot by the radio, sunlight through the window
sfx: warm radio crackle, indistinct grateful voice, gulls

title: The lantern holds
action: Penny checks the stable drive gear.
camera: close-up on the turning gear
sfx: smooth gear ticking, gentle hum

title: Tomkin’s medal
action: Penny pins a brass washer to Tomkin’s cape.
camera: medium shot, mock ceremony
sfx: gentle wind, clapping, gulls

title: A quiet breakfast
action: The three share bread on the balcony.
camera: slow orbit around the trio sitting on the catwalk
sfx: gentle waves, gulls, bread tearing, laughter

title: The horizon clears
action: Golden light stretches over a peaceful ocean.
camera: sweeping aerial shot over the calm ocean
sfx: calm waves, gulls, soft breeze

title: A final joke
action: Tomkin salutes with his bent ladle and slips into the tub.
camera: medium shot on Tomkin, comic timing
sfx: wobble, plastic thunk, squeak

title: Friends at the lighthouse
action: Penny and the hero laugh and help him upright.
camera: two-shot widening to three
sfx: laughter, gulls, waves

title: The closing image
action: The camera pulls back to the restored shining lighthouse.
camera: long continuous pull-back and rise away from the catwalk
sfx: soft wind, waves, gulls

title: End credits
action: Credits roll over waves, lighthouse and sunrise.
camera: slow drift over waves toward the distant lighthouse at sunrise
sfx: gentle waves, soft breeze
